editor.premise: A mountain expedition unfolds from city preparations to remote camps, balancing difficult travel, daily routines, and glimpses of the route ahead.

chapters.name: City stop
chapters.purpose: Begin the chronology with sightseeing, food, and social encounters.

chapters.name: Mountain arrival
chapters.purpose: Move from the city into the expedition's mountain setting.

chapters.name: Meet the team
chapters.purpose: Introduce the expedition support and explain the trip's origins.

chapters.name: Road approach
chapters.purpose: Show the difficult journey to the walking route.

chapters.name: First walking day
chapters.purpose: Establish trail routines, pack transport, and changing weather.

chapters.name: Camp routines
chapters.purpose: Turn arrival into shelter, dinner, breakfast, and departure preparations.

chapters.name: Second walking day
chapters.purpose: Advance along the valley and establish the next camp.

chapters.name: Onto the glacier
chapters.purpose: Introduce rougher terrain and expand the scale of the trek.

captions.note: Mostly centered place labels and lower-corner day statistics; brief food labels, visual jokes, and longer message overlays interrupt the geographical signposting.

editor.notes: Use the opening to promise terrain and hardship, then restart chronologically. Compress walking into short samples; hold views, meals, and practical camp details longer. Repeat preview images later so the opening's promises become recognizable milestones.
